## Requirement

Add an **Upcoming Milestones** section to the weekly update.

Show milestones due within the next **30 days** from a configurable report date.

For each matching milestone, show:

- project;
- milestone;
- owner;
- due date.

## Constraints

- Keep the starter project simple.
- Keep it dependency-free.
- Work on a dedicated branch.
- Use the standard inspect → plan → implement → validate → review workflow.

## Pull request expectations

Explain:

- why the change exists;
- what changed;
- how it was validated;
- anything that deserves technical review.
